clips.title: The story
paras: Felix's Chest lies in a Frostmane camp southwest of Anvilmar. It holds belongings lost by the exiled gnome during the flight from Gnomeregan.

Felix Whindlebolt fled Gnomeregan with the other gnomes when troggs and toxic radioactive fallout drove them from the city. The refugees crossed into snowy Dun Morogh with whatever they could carry. In the confusion, Frostmane trolls scavenged the roads and overtook scattered survivors. Felix lost his toolkits and belongings, and the trolls hauled his sturdy chest to their camps in the crags southwest of Anvilmar.
